name: playwright
description: Cross-browser automation — Chrome, Firefox, Safari. Richer than Puppeteer
pitfalls: Downloads browser binaries on first run (~300MB for all 3 browsers)
52 tools with full schema = ~28K tokens in context (mcptoon: 0)
More tools than Puppeteer but heavier install
notes: Cross-browser alternative to Puppeteer. Supports Firefox and Safari in addition to Chrome. With mcptoon, context cost is always 0 regardless of tool count.

permissions: read: web pages, DOM across browsers
write: form inputs, JS execution, file downloads
